summary: Scans a global array of 7-dword entries from dword_7D1B08 up to but excluding dword_7D1FD8. For each entry whose first two dwords match the two dwords of the incoming pair pointer, the matched entry is rewritten to 0 and 89. Returns the scan pointer after the array bound. Called from ControllerShifterMapping at 0x0046A9C0.

local_names.a1: pointer to a 2-dword ID pair to match
local_names.result: scan pointer over the global entry array, advanced by 7 dwords per iteration

operations.description: Iterate scan pointer from dword_7D1B08 to dword_7D1FD8, advancing 7 dwords per entry
Set matched entry second dword: result[1] = 89
Return the scan pointer, now one past the last scanned entry

unresolved: Meaning of the literal 89 written into the second dword of a matched entry
Structure of the 7-dword array entries beyond the first two ID dwords
Why the first two entry dwords are cleared to 0/89 rather than fully removed
